name: awesome-llm-json
desc: Resource list for generating JSON using LLMs via function calling, tools, CFG. Libraries, Models, Notebooks, etc.

resources.name: Structured Outputs
resources.desc: Using an LLM to generate any structured output including JSON, XML, or YAML regardless of technique (e.g. function calling, guided generation).

resources.name: Function Calling
resources.desc: Providing an LLM a hypothetical (or actual) function definition for it to "call" in it's chat or completion response. The LLM doesn't actually call the function, it just provides an indication that one should be called via a JSON message.

resources.name: JSON Mode
resources.desc: Specifying that an LLM must generate valid JSON. Depending on the provider, a schema may or may not be specified and the LLM may create an unexpected schema.

resources.name: Tool Usage
resources.desc: Giving an LLM a choice of tools such as image generation, web search, and "function calling". The functional calling parameter in the API request is now called "tools".

resources.name: Guided Generation
resources.desc: For constraining an LLM model to generate text that follows a prescribed specification such as a Context-Free Grammar.

resources.name: GPT Actions
resources.desc: ChatGPT invokes actions (i.e. API calls) based on the endpoints and parameters specified in an OpenAPI specification. Unlike the capability called "Function Calling", this capability will indeed call your function hosted by an API server.
